existing_group_assignments.rationale: Increase, Necrosis is a form of increased cell death, matching the cell death/apoptosis group of varying specificity.
Increase, TNF is a specific increased pro-inflammatory mediator and fits the increased mediators group.

new_groups.rationale: Both describe altered expression of otic development genes (six1b increased, eya1 inhibited) in the same developmental pathway; flagged for curator review.
Prolongation of action potential duration (cellular) and QT interval prolongation (organ-level ECG) are the same process at different biological scales.
Increased activation of platelets versus neutrophils: the same process in different cell types.
Decline of neural progenitor cells and premature differentiation are related neural progenitor events; flagged for curator review of specificity.
Increased tumor growth (general) and metastatic breast cancer (tissue-specific) describe related tumor progression at different specificity.
